title: Common definitions
description: Shared primitives referenced by every other contract schema. Not a document type by itself.

uuid.description: Entity id. UUID (v7 generated server-side; time-ordered).

nodeId.description: Document-local node id. Stable across revisions; unique inside one document (checked semantically, not by schema).

key.description: Machine key (stable identifier used in references, formulas and bindings).

semver.description: Semantic version MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH (no pre-release in v1).

semverRange.description: Caret range on a major version, e.g. '^1.2.0'. Only caret ranges are allowed in v1.

schemaVersion.description: Integer version of the contract the JSON conforms to. Bumped only with a registered migration.

localizedText.description: Plain text (never HTML). Either a single string or a per-locale map.

unit.description: Unit symbol from the platform unit catalog (UCUM-like). Empty string = dimensionless.

tokenRef.description: Reference to a design token of the active theme, e.g. {"$token": "color.surface.raised"}.

cssLength.description: Restricted CSS length. No calc()/url()/expressions: values are emitted into CSS custom properties.

color.description: Hex/rgb(a) color literal. Named CSS keywords and functions other than rgb/rgba are rejected.

oneOf.description: Enumerated CSS keyword (e.g. 'flex-start', 'bold'); the style engine whitelists keywords per property.

styleBlock.description: Whitelisted style properties. Free-form CSS is not accepted.

metadata.description: Editor-only metadata. Ignored by the runtime renderer.

expression.description: Formula in the platform expression grammar (see expression.schema.json). Character whitelist blocks quotes, brackets, backslashes, semicolons and assignment; the server parser is authoritative.
